verdict.summary: The change correctly extends cooperative budget enforcement through SELECT-JSON serialization. The serial path checks periodically and performs a sticky final gate before emitting the closing JSON suffix; the parallel path uses the thread-local budget snapshot in Rayon workers and performs the authoritative on-thread gate before closing the response. Thus cancellation or timeout cannot yield a syntactically complete truncated response. The added test is non-vacuous: cancellation is raised only by the first sink invocation, proving the pre-serialization check passed, and it covers both below-threshold and default-feature parallel-sized results while also checking byte-identical success output. Documentation matches the streamed-response caveat and the existing fail-closed design.
